label: Rosie 1400, link_6 gun
notes: The gun baked into `link_6` of rosie_1400_v3 -- about 30 mm across all the way to the tip, because the mesh IS the hardware. Twice the nozzle above. A Ø32 tube needs roughly 20 mm to clear a flat plate at a 45° work angle, which is what a seam's authored `standoff_mm` profile has to allow for on this cell; the authoring side once checked clearance for a Ø16 nozzle this cell does not have. Pick this one on this cell.
